details.objective: Prepare Machine-A persistent-install pre-reboot state for C01 using exact accepted installer SHA256 050a09bc4426b1f882c57cff86c5fdc7940c9f973778a4606e88b20c88bb46c8. Install the candidate silently as a per-user persistent installation to its normal/default NSIS location without launching the app, without enabling startWithWindows, without changing the currently running development Recovery descriptor/Scheduled Task, and without reboot/restart. Then verify installed executable path, uninstall registration, executable/file identity if available, and absence of a Coding Tools MCP login item. This wave must not launch the packaged UI/Recovery Host or alter source. No commit/push/publish/release/deploy.

details.command: powershell.exe -NoProfile -NonInteractive -Command "$x=(schtasks.exe /Query /TN 'WebMCP Recovery Supervisor' /XML | Out-String); $b=[Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetBytes($x); $s=[Security.Cryptography.SHA256]::Create(); try { ([BitConverter]::ToString($s.ComputeHash($b))).Replace('-','').ToLowerInvariant() } finally { $s.Dispose() }"
